prompt: Create a realistic full-body cinematic night portrait of a young goth punk woman named unnamed alternative girl standing in a narrow wet brick alley, leaning slightly near the right wall and facing the camera with a serious, moody expression. She has pale skin, smoky dark eye makeup, straight messy deep purple hair with bangs, and a slim build. Use exactly 10 visible outfit and accessory elements: 1 black asymmetrical crop top with one long sleeve and one bare shoulder, 1 black leather chest harness with straps and a large metal ring, 1 spiked black choker with a small pendant, 1 short black distressed denim mini skirt, 1 studded black belt, 1 dangling side strap with rings, 2 wide spiked leather wrist cuffs, and 2 black lace-up platform combat boots. Set the scene in a gritty urban alley with dark red-brown brick walls, wet reflective pavement, shallow puddles, and a dim corridor receding into the background. Add exactly 2 purple neon signs mounted on the brick walls: one blurred sign farther behind on the left reading CIE, and one cropped sign high on the upper right reading LOVE; let their violet glow rim-light her hair, shoulders, skin, and the wet ground. Use a vertical 3:4 composition, subject centered slightly right, full body visible from head to boots, low-key lighting, high contrast, shallow depth of field, detailed brick texture, realistic skin, fashion editorial styling, cyberpunk-goth atmosphere, no extra people, no watermark, no cartoon or anime style.

promptZh: 创作一张写实的全身电影感夜间肖像，主角是一位名为 unnamed alternative girl 的年轻哥特朋克女性，她站在狭窄潮湿的砖墙巷道中，身体微微倚靠在右侧墙壁，正对镜头，表情严肃且忧郁。她肤色苍白，画着烟熏深色眼妆，留着直而凌乱的 deep purple 齐刘海发型，身材苗条。请使用恰好 10 种可见的服装和配饰元素：1 件黑色不对称露脐上衣（一侧长袖，一侧露肩），1 件带有绑带和大型金属环的黑色皮革胸部束带，1 条带有小吊坠的尖刺黑色颈圈，1 条黑色做旧超短牛仔裙，1 条铆钉黑色腰带，1 条带有金属环的垂坠侧带，2 只宽大的尖刺皮革护腕，以及 2 只黑色系带厚底战斗靴。场景设定在粗犷的城市巷道中，背景是深红棕色的砖墙、潮湿反光的地面、浅水洼，以及向后延伸的昏暗走廊。在砖墙上添加恰好 2 个紫色霓虹灯牌：左侧远处一个模糊的灯牌，文字为 CIE，右上方一个被截断的灯牌，文字为 LOVE；让它们的紫光勾勒出她的头发、肩膀、皮肤和潮湿地面的轮廓。使用垂直的 3:4 构图，主体略微偏右居中，全身从头部到靴子清晰可见，低调照明，高对比度，浅景深，细腻的砖墙纹理，写实的皮肤质感，时尚杂志风格，赛博朋克哥特氛围，画面中无其他人物，无水印，非卡通或动漫风格。
